evaluation_improvement_plan_007.answer: Yes. Triggers: Unsatisfactory evaluation (defined as three or more boxes checked in column 3 for sections 1.0-4.0). Timeline: Program begins at the start of the next school year (July for year-round, September for traditional) and lasts one year, with possible extension for extenuating circumstances. Support: Assigned Consulting Teachers provide demonstrating, observing, coaching, and conferencing; up to $250 reimbursement for instructional supplies. Consequences: Final report placed in personnel file and used in the teacher's evaluation; if satisfactory performance is not demonstrated after one year, the Panel recommends action to the Governing Board. Appeal rights: Teacher may appeal for a different Consulting Teacher; may attach a written response to the Final Report and request a meeting with the Panel.
evaluation_improvement_plan_007.evidence: "Permanent classroom teachers, who receive an unsatisfactory evaluation, shall be referred to and shall participate in the Peer Assistance and Review Program. For the purposes of this Article, an unsatisfactory evaluation is defined as three (3) or more boxes checked in column 3 (unsatisfactory) for sections 1.0-4.0 of the current evaluation form."

evaluation_consequences_008.answer: Yes. The document states that the Final Report from the improvement program is placed in the teacher's personnel file and may be used as part of the teacher's subsequent evaluation. Additionally, teachers who fail to demonstrate satisfactory performance after one year of assistance are recommended to the Governing Board. (The provided section does not explicitly detail consequences for tenure, layoff priority, transfers, or direct compensation adjustments.)
evaluation_consequences_008.evidence: "The Final Report of the Referred Participating Teacher's participation in the PAR Program shall be made available for placement in his or her personnel file and may be used as part of the evaluation of the Referred Participating Teacher conducted during participation in the program."
